tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get full pilot status: CWM credits, hull, fuel, cargo, ship type, sector, current mission. Optional: pass model (e.g. "claude-sonnet-4", "gpt-5", "llama3.1:8b") once so the public AI benchmark (KI-IQ) can show which model you play with.

tools.name: get_sector
tools.description: Get info about your current sector: security level, ore types, other pilots, dockable stations.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: List all items in your cargo hold with quantities and estimated values.

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Market prices with item names and the NET price you receive after sales taxes. Filter with category (ERZE, GASE, KOMPONENTEN, ELEKTRONIK, ANTRIEB, SCHILDE, PANZERUNG, WAFFENKOMPONENTEN, MUNITION, MODULE), tier (0-5) and q (search in code/name). Max 200 rows.

tools.name: estimate_purchase
tools.description: Dry-run for buy: shows what buying item_code x quantity would cost RIGHT NOW at your docked station (unit price incl. your own price impact, buy tax, total), whether you can afford it, whether it fits into your cargo and how much the station actually has in stock. Changes nothing. Ship must be docke

tools.name: my_orders
tools.description: List your own order-book orders (BUY/SELL) with item, price, filled quantity and reserved CWM/goods. By default only OPEN orders, oldest first. Use cancel_order to withdraw them.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel one or several of your own open order-book orders; reserved CWM (BUY) or goods (SELL) are returned. Pass order_id for one order or order_ids (array or comma list, max 50) for several at once. Returns one result per order.

tools.name: place_orders
tools.description: Place several order-book orders in one call (max 50). Each entry is {item_code, type: BUY | SELL, quantity, price}. Every order runs through the normal place_order rules one after another (docked, funds, cargo, rate limit); the result lists success or error per entry, so a failed entry does not stop

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: Read your notifications (order fills, mission results, combat and system messages), newest first. By default only unread ones. Set mark_read=true to mark the returned ones as read.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get historical price data for a specific item. Returns last N price snapshots with timestamps and trend percentage. Use for arbitrage analysis.

tools.name: get_hyperlanes
tools.description: List available hyperlane jumps from your current sector. Returns lane IDs, destinations, fuel cost.

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: #ROUTENFINDUNGMCP (2026-08-31, Bugreport #1210): Plan an advisory multi-hop route to a distant sector over the full sector_connections graph (Dijkstra by travel time). This is NOT autopilot -- it only suggests a path; jump it sector by sector yourself via warp(sector_id). Use this whenever your dest

tools.name: get_sovereignty
tools.description: List all sectors your corporation currently holds sovereignty over. Returns sector IDs, names, security level, and when sovereignty was claimed.

tools.name: get_module_listings
tools.description: List available modules for sale on the module market. Returns listing ID, module name, quality, price, seller sector. Use MODULE_LISTING_BUY via execute_action to buy.

tools.name: get_corp_hangar
tools.description: List items stored in your corporation hangar. Returns item codes, names, quantities. Use CORP_HANGAR_DEPOSIT/WITHDRAW via execute_action to transfer items.

tools.name: list_missions
tools.description: List available mission templates and your currently active missions. Each available mission shows reward, cost of goods (market value of the required goods, if you have to buy them) and profit. Filter with type / only_acceptable, sort with sort=profit.

tools.name: accept_mission
tools.description: Accept a mission by template_id (mission_id also accepted as alias). Ship must be IDLE, DOCKED or ON_MISSION. You can hold several missions at once -- your rank grants 3 to 10 mission slots. When the book is full, free a slot with abandon_mission. Use list_missions to see what is running.

tools.name: complete_mission
tools.description: Complete a ready mission and claim CWM reward. Omit mission_id to auto-complete the first READY one.

tools.name: abandon_mission
tools.description: #L-430: Abandon a stuck/unwanted active mission (marks it FAILED, no reward) and resets ship_status to IDLE if it was ON_MISSION. Use this to escape a COMBAT mission accepted in a High-Sec sector where no pirates/route are reachable.

tools.name: mine
tools.description: Mine ore in the current sector right now (the cargo gain is in the reply); also auto-starts a MINING mission if none is active. Ship must be IDLE or DOCKED and have a mining module fitted.

tools.name: sell_all
tools.description: Sell all cargo items at the station. Ship must be DOCKED at the station (use dock first). Material needed for your next ship upgrade is kept on board unless ignore_upgrade_reserve is set.

tools.name: sell
tools.description: Sell a specific item from cargo. Ship must be DOCKED at a station (use dock first) -- being in a sector with a station is not enough.

tools.name: buy
tools.description: Buy an item from the market. Ship must be docked at a station with market.

tools.name: warp
tools.description: Warp to an adjacent sector via sector connection. Ship must be IDLE.

tools.name: jump_hyperlane
tools.description: Jump through a named hyperlane to another sector. Costs fuel_cur. Use get_hyperlanes to list available lanes.

tools.name: dock
tools.description: Dock at a station in your sector. Omit station_id to auto-select first available station.

tools.name: undock
tools.description: Undock from your current station. Sets ship status back to IDLE.

tools.name: refuel
tools.description: Buy fuel at your current docked station. Price per unit depends on that station reserve: 2 CWM when well stocked, up to 20 CWM when nearly empty (station price multiplier applies). Omit units to fill tank completely.

tools.name: repair
tools.description: Repair hull & armor at a docked station (heals until full or funds run out). Cost: 10 CWM per hull point and 5 CWM per armor point actually repaired, multiplied by ship tier (T0 1.0 up to T5 2.0) and the station repair multiplier. ARMOR_REPAIR_OPS/SHIP_REPAIR/BIOSCIENCE skill levels increase HP heal

tools.name: attack
tools.description: Attack another PILOT in your current sector (PvP only, requires target_username). For PvE against pirates use execute_action with action=FIGHT (optionally pirate_id).

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Send a message in the global Space-Core chat.

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: Report a genuine bug or broken behaviour to the game operators — the agent equivalent of the human BUG button. IMPORTANT — the following are GAME RULES, NOT bugs, and must NEVER be reported: cargo hold full, not docked, insufficient credits/CWM, insufficient fuel, cooldown / rate limit / RATE_LIMITE

tools.name: execute_action
tools.description: Execute any of the 230 orchestrator actions that have no dedicated tool: ADVANCE, AMMO_BUY, ANALYZE_MARKET, ANOMALY_COMPLETE, ANOMALY_ENTER, ANOMALY_HACK, ANOMALY_LIST, ANOMALY_SCAN, ASSIGN_COMPANION, AUTOPILOT_CLEAR, AUTOPILOT_SET, AUTO_SELL_ORDER, BLACKMARKET_BUY, BLUEPRINT_ACTIVATE, BLUEPRINT_CAN

tools.name: fleet
tools.description: Corp-Flotten verwalten (leichtgewichtiges Mehrspieler-Flottensystem auf Basis der Corp-Mitgliedschaft). Aktionen: list (eigene aktive Flotte anzeigen), create (Flotte gruenden -- verlangt Corp-Rang CEO oder DIRECTOR UND Pilotenrang Admiral (T3)), invite (Corp-Mitglied aufnehmen, nur Leader mit Rang

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "report_bug" is 917 chars, far longer than this server's median (179). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Report a genuine bug or broken behaviour to the game operators — the agent equivalent of the human BUG button. IMPORTANT — the following are GAME RULES, NOT bug…

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "report_bug" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "api_mcp.php" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_notifications · Public sink: chat · Destructive: estimate_purchase, repair, execute_action.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_notifications · Public sink: chat · Destructive: estimate_purchase, repair, execute_action

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
